# clumio_dynamodb_backups (Data Source)

clumio_dynamodb_backups data source is used to retrieve details of the backups of a DynamoDB table for use in other resources or actions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example retrieving all backups of a DynamoDB table. The backups are sorted newest first, so
# backups[0].id is the ID of the latest backup.
data "clumio_dynamodb_backups" "example_backups" {
  table_id = "Clumio-assigned ID of the DynamoDB table"
}

# Example retrieving the SecureVault backups of a DynamoDB table taken at or before a given time
data "clumio_dynamodb_backups" "example_backups_before" {
  table_id         = "Clumio-assigned ID of the DynamoDB table"
  type             = "clumio_backup"
  before_timestamp = "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `table_id` (String) Unique identifier of the DynamoDB table whose backups are to be retrieved.

### Optional

- `after_timestamp` (String) If specified, only backups whose start timestamp is after the given timestamp are retrieved. Represented in RFC-3339 format.
- `before_timestamp` (String) If specified, only backups whose start timestamp is at or before the given timestamp are retrieved. Represented in RFC-3339 format.
- `type` (String) The type of backups to retrieve. Possible values include `clumio_backup` and `aws_snapshot`. If not specified, backups of all types are retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) List of DynamoDB table backups which matched the query criteria, sorted by start timestamp with the most recent backup first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `expiration_timestamp` (String) The timestamp of when this backup expires. Represented in RFC-3339 format.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the DynamoDB table backup.
- `start_timestamp` (String) The timestamp of when this backup started. Represented in RFC-3339 format.
- `type` (String) The type of the backup. Possible values include `clumio_backup` and `aws_snapshot`.
